system.description:
• Effect: Make an Intelligence check to perceive invisible objects or creatures — does not fully reveal them, only their general location and movement. Make the check once per round, as no action, while an invisible creature or object is within 30ft.
  • From 18th level: after a successful check, can now determine the shape and size of the invisible target

activities.name: See Invisible
activities.text: Perceive the general location and movement of an invisible creature or object within 30ft.
